# GitHub Pages deployment

The current repository publishes directly from the `gh-pages` branch (root).
Build and lint locally, then commit the generated output to that branch.
`pages-workflow.reference.yml` preserves the previous Actions configuration as a reference; it is not enabled.

Current repository: https://github.com/kwnf684-pixel/090990999
Current site: https://kwnf684-pixel.github.io/090990999/
The previous `origin` remote is retained; `customer` is the current publishing remote.
